name: belancer_com-mcp
description: Belancer (deals): me, search_postings, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_belancer_com_username.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BELANCER_COM_USERNAME
platform_mcp_belancer_com_username.description: E-mail address of your Belancer account (POST /auth/login validates username as an e-mail).

platform_mcp_belancer_com_password.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BELANCER_COM_PASSWORD
platform_mcp_belancer_com_password.description: Password of the same Belancer account.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: GET /projects/search ('Search Projects'): query, category_id (integer), min_budget, page (default 1), limit (default 10), status=open fixed. The OpenAPI gives no response schema; the live response (2026-09-24) is {total, page, limit, projects[]} with id, name, description, currency, min_budget, max_budget, posted_by, created_at — mapped from that. skills[] item shape is undocumented (raw).

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET /projects/{project_id} ('Get Project'; integer id); same record shape as a search hit (live response 2026-09-24).
